INTRODUCTION
Zyro Dynamics recognises that flexible work arrangements are an important part of employee wellbeing,
productivity, and retention. This policy establishes a structured and consistent framework for employees to work
from a location other than their designated Zyro Dynamics office. The Company expects that all WFH
arrangements will be exercised responsibly and that the quality and timeliness of work will not be compromised
under any circumstances.
SCOPE AND APPLICABILITY
This policy applies to all permanent employees at grade L3 and above across all Zyro Dynamics office locations.
Employees on probation, employees at grades L1 and L2, and employees deployed at client sites are not eligible
for WFH arrangements unless approved in writing by the HR Director on a case-by-case basis.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
To be considered for a WFH arrangement, an employee must satisfy all of the following at the time of the request:
  Completed a minimum of 6 months of continuous service at Zyro Dynamics.
 Currently holding grade L3 or above.
 Has received a performance rating of Meets Expectations or above in the most recent performance review
cycle.
 Has no active Performance Improvement Plan or ongoing disciplinary proceedings.
 The nature of the role is assessed as suitable for remote execution by the reporting manager.
 A reliable internet connection with a minimum speed of 25 Mbps is available at the remote location, along
with a dedicated, distraction-free workspace.
APPROVAL PROCESS
Employees must submit a WFH request through the ZyroHR portal under the Work Arrangements section at
least 2 working days before the intended WFH date, except in the case of ad-hoc requests. The reporting
manager must review and action the request within 1 working day. HR will verify eligibility for the first-time setup
of a Hybrid or Full Remote arrangement. IT will ensure VPN access and any required equipment is ready before
the arrangement commences.
EMPLOYEE RESPONSIBILITIES WHILE WORKING FROM HOME
Availability and Communication
  The employee must be fully available and responsive during agreed working hours. Absence from
communication channels for more than 30 minutes during working hours without prior notice is treated as an
attendance exception.
 Video must be enabled during all scheduled meetings and calls, unless explicitly waived by the meeting
organiser.
 Status on company communication tools must accurately reflect actual availability at all times.

Workspace and Equipment
  All work must be performed exclusively on the company-issued laptop. Personal devices must not be used
for any work activity involving company or customer data.
 A dedicated workspace free from personal interruptions must be maintained during working hours.
 VPN must be active at all times when accessing Zyro Dynamics systems remotely.
Confidentiality
  Confidential documents and screens must not be visible to family members or any third party.
 Printing of confidential or customer-related documents at home is strictly prohibited.
 The screen must be locked within 5 minutes of inactivity.

NON-COMPLIANCE
Failure to comply with this policy will be addressed progressively. A first instance of non-compliance will result in
a verbal warning and suspension of WFH privilege for 30 days. A second instance will result in a written warning
and suspension for 90 days. Repeated violations will lead to permanent revocation of WFH eligibility and may be
escalated to the formal disciplinary process.
